hint: drag to place · wheel turns the part under the cursor · RMB removes · C shares a code · TAB or ESC closes
part_stats: cells %d   cost %d ticks, one per cell   heat %.1f

dead.title: DEAD CODE
dead.body: These parts are wired in a ring with no way out. A flow that gets in goes round until its life runs out, and nothing comes of it.

readout.life: LIFE %d · hold %s for more, release to fire

share.heading: SHARE CODE
share.uncodeable: — this board cannot be put into a code —
share.hint: type either case · ENTER builds · ESC closes
share.prompt: Type a code in, or PASTE one from the clipboard.
share.no_clipboard_read: There is no clipboard here — read the code off the sheet.
share.no_clipboard_write: There is no clipboard here — type the code in.
share.clipboard_empty: There is no code on the clipboard.
share.nothing_to_build: Nothing to build — type or paste a code first.
share.no_board: There is no board open to build onto.
share.wrong_size: That build was laid out on a %dx%d board; this one is %dx%d.
share.short_of: Short of %s — nothing has been spent.

code_error.mistyped: That code does not check out — a character is wrong, its case is wrong, or two of them have swapped.
code_error.truncated: That code stops in the middle of a board.
code_error.impossible: That code does not describe a board that can be built.
code_error.has_zero: There is a 0 in that. A code has no zero in it — the round character is the letter O, capital or small.
code_error.empty: There is no code in that.
code_error.length: No code is %d characters long — one has been missed out, or one added.
code_error.version: That code is version %d; this game reads version %d.
code_error.unknown_part: That code carries a part this version of the game does not have.

problem.no_input: No INPUT placed — the flow has nowhere to start.
problem.side_entry: %s at %d,%d is entered through its tail. Flow can only go in the head cell.
problem.head_on: %s at %d,%d sends its own flow back this way. Two outputs cannot meet.
problem.leak: The flow leaves %d,%d heading %s and finds nothing there.
problem.dead_loop: The flow runs into a ring with no way out and goes round there until its life runs out. Turn a part in the ring so that something leads out of it.
problem.no_output: The chain never reaches an OUTPUT.
problem.no_form: The flow reaches an OUTPUT, but no attack form is on the path.
problem.expired: The flow runs out of life (%d) before it reaches an OUTPUT. Shorten it, or hold the cast button to charge it further.
